properties.name: Re-linking a registered file to a second target re-measures it and MOVES its drift baseline, with no disposition and nothing in the reply saying a baseline moved
properties.statement:
OBSERVED 2026-09-30 (reflow2 0.75.0, `--call` door, a worktree-private copy of reflow2's own design). A registered Artifact whose file had changed since its baseline (baseline sha256:45d30218…, file now sha256:4f296a3f…) was linked to a SECOND target with `link_artifact` — artifact_id, target_id and completeness only, no checksum. The reply's `measurement` block reported `basis: measured` and the new digest; `get_node` afterwards showed the stored `checksum` replaced by the new digest. No ChangeEvent, no disposition, no CHANGED edge.

EXPECTED: a re-link to another target leaves the drift baseline where it was — the tool description says re-linking is SAFE and never renames or drops prose, and says nothing about the baseline — so the drift stays reported until it is accepted two-sided with `set_artifact_checksum`, whose own description says "Silent accept does not exist". As observed, attaching a changed file to a new capability IS a silent accept of whatever changed since the last baseline, and `reconcile_artifacts` then reports the file clean.

WORKAROUND USED: accepted the new content explicitly anyway with `set_artifact_checksums` (disposition `design_updated`, naming the ChangeEvent) so the record carries the disposition; for a file whose drift you have not reviewed, run `reconcile_artifacts` BEFORE re-linking it. Not root-caused; recorded as a to-do under rule 11.
